thesis: During periods of sustained price decline, a significant drawdown from recent lows, as measured by the exponential z-score of lows, tends to coincide with a persistent streak of falling absolute closing prices. This relationship emerges because sharp, sustained selling pressure not only pushes prices lower but also erodes investor confidence, leading to consecutive down days as momentum traders exit positions. Consequently, this pattern signals a high-momentum downtrend where price recovery is unlikely until the streak of negative closes is broken.
